info.name: UniLMS - Student Portal & Mobile App API Suite
info.description:
### UniLMS Standalone Student Portal & Mobile App API Suite

This collection is structured to match the **UniLMS Student Portal Navigation Menu** exactly:
- **00. Authentication & Session** (Login, Logout, Silent Refresh, Current Profile)
- **01. Academics & Learning** (Dashboard, Assessments, CBT Quizzes, Timetable, Attendance, Grade Card, Course Materials, OBE Matrix)
- **02. Career & Industry** (Industry Internships, Placements Hub)
- **03. Campus Life & Services** (Fee Ledger, Self Service Desk, Certificate Requests, Exam Registration, Academic Diary, Hostel, Transport, Grievance, Course Feedback)

**Zero-Configuration Setup:**
All variables are embedded in the collection. Developers do not need a separate environment file.
Executing **01. Student Multi-Tenant Login** automatically saves `token`, `refreshToken`, `studentId`, and `tenantCode` into collection variables for all subsequent requests.

variable.description: Base API endpoint. Use https://api.unilms.in/api/v1 for production or http://localhost:3000/api/v1 for local testing.
Your institution Campus Code (e.g. MST, DEMO, ORG1).
Student Roll Number or registered institutional Email address.
Bearer JWT access token automatically populated upon calling Login.
Long-lived refresh token automatically populated upon calling Login.
Active student profile UUID automatically populated upon calling Login.

item.name: 00. Authentication & Session
item.description: Multi-tenant authentication, session establishment, silent token refresh, and logout routines for student mobile apps.

request.description: Authenticates student using institution Campus Code, Roll Number / Email, and Password. Automatically parses and sets collection variables (token, refreshToken, studentId, tenantCode).
Renews expired access token silently in background using stored refreshToken.
Terminates mobile active session and clears auth variables from local client storage.
Fetches verified profile dossier, enrollment status, cohort batch, section, and contact details for logged-in student.

item.name: 01. Academics & Learning
item.description: Core curriculum, daily attendance, class timetable, LMS materials, CBT tests, grade cards, and OBE accreditation metrics.

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: Home screen 360 overview, digital ID card, academic calendar, and summary counters.

request.description: Primary dashboard payload returning student profile photo, overall attendance %, fee balance, today scheduled periods, and class teacher.

item.name: 02. Get Verified Student Digital ID Card Dossier

request.description: Generates secure verified mobile student ID with barcode, academic batch, validity, blood group, and emergency contact numbers.
Full semester institutional calendar listing instructional class days, sports days, celebrations, and exam windows.
Micro-counters for pending helpdesk tickets, certificate issuance status, and circular alerts.

item.name: Assessments & Assignments
item.description: Subject assignments, homework submissions, teacher grading, and project guidelines.

request.description: Returns active subject assignments, due dates, attachments, student submissions, and teacher evaluation comments.
Downloadable project rubrics, assignment guidelines, and reference problem sets.

item.name: CBT Quizzes & Tests
item.description: Online proctored computer-based test center, real-time timer state, and autosave heartbeat.

request.description: Returns list of upcoming, live active, and evaluated CBT assessments.
Detailed assessment instructions, negative marking criteria, total questions, and maximum duration in minutes.

item.name: 03. Start or Resume CBT Test Session

request.description: Initializes or reconnects to an active CBT session with server-validated countdown timer.

item.name: 04. Get Live CBT Exam Player State

request.description: Fetches question set, multiple choice options, saved choices, and server remaining time in seconds.
Silent background sync keeping active answers persisted and syncing timer.
Concludes exam attempt, submits responses for automated grading, and records score in student gradebook.

item.name: Class Timetable
item.description: Weekly schedule (Monday–Saturday) with period timings, subject codes, faculty instructors, and room numbers.

request.description: Returns student section weekly schedule covering Period 1 to Period 7, tea/lunch intervals, faculty names, and lecture halls.

item.name: Attendance Monitor
item.description: Overall attendance rate, buffer analysis (safe bunk sessions), monthly calendar grid, and public holidays.

item.name: 01. Get Cumulative Attendance Summary & Roll-Call Logs

request.description: Overall attendance %, minimum 75% cutoff status, safe buffer sessions, subject-wise breakdown, and verified classroom logs signed by faculty.
Filters attendance records for a specific calendar month view to calculate monthly percentage and present/absent counts.
List of institutional and national holidays (Republic Day, Gandhi Jayanti, Diwali) recognized as non-instructional days.

item.name: Semester Grade Card
item.description: Semester-wise academic transcripts, internal/external exam marks, SGPA/CGPA, and university exam dates.

item.name: 01. Get Student Marks & Semester Grade Card

request.description: Continuous internal evaluation (CIE), end-semester exam marks, credits earned, and SGPA/CGPA standing.
Official schedule for mid-term and end-term university examinations.

item.name: Course Materials & Notes
item.description: Lecture notes, syllabus PDFs, presentation decks, and digital video courses.

request.description: Downloadable PDF notes, presentation slides, and curriculum references grouped by course subject.
Catalog of published self-paced online courses and masterclasses available on campus.

item.name: 03. Get My Enrolled Courses & Learning Progress

request.description: Enrolled courses, completed video percentages, and lesson certificates.
Detailed modular syllabus, video streaming links, and lesson transcripts.
Enrolls logged-in student into a campus online masterclass or technical skill track.

item.name: OBE Outcomes & Matrix
item.description: Accredited Program Outcomes (PO1–PO12, PSO1–PSO2) and Course Outcome (CO-PO) articulation matrix.

request.description: Fetches persistent Washington Accord Tier-1 outcomes (PO1 to PO12, PSO1, PSO2) auto-provisioned from PostgreSQL.
Subject-level Course Outcomes (CO1-CO5) correlated against Program Outcomes (1=Low, 2=Medium, 3=High).

item.name: 02. Career & Industry
item.description: Verified industry internships, on-campus recruitment drives, job applications tracking, and official offer letters.

item.name: Industry Internships
item.description: Verified internship openings, company profiles, stipends, and application guidelines.

request.description: Returns available corporate internships, locations, stipend amounts, and eligibility requirements.

item.name: Placements Hub
item.description: Campus placement drives, job roles, rounds tracking, resume applications, and job offer letters.

request.description: Active recruitment drives, hiring partners, CTC packages, criteria cutoffs, and scheduled test dates.
Track application statuses across Shortlisting, Technical Rounds, HR Interview, and Final Selection.
Applies to recruitment drive with student resume link and CGPA clearance.
Official campus job offer letters, confirmed CTC packages, designation, and joining instructions.

item.name: 03. Campus Life & Services
item.description: Fee ledger, self-service desk, certificates, exam registrations, academic diary, hostel, bus transport, grievances, and faculty feedback.

item.name: Fee Ledger & Dues
item.description: Academic fee ledger, term invoices, paid transaction receipts, and pending balance (matching web portal).

item.name: 01. Get Fee Invoices, Receipts & Pending Balance

request.description: Detailed statement of tuition, lab, library, hostel fees, payment transaction receipts, and outstanding dues.

item.name: Self Service Desk
item.description: Campus helpdesk overview, active circulars, and institutional push notifications.

request.description: Quick metrics on open grievance tickets, certificate approvals, and academic notifications.
Official university circulars, exam notices, and student welfare bulletins.
Push notification feed for classroom attendance, assignment deadlines, and hostel gate approvals.

item.name: Certificate Requests
item.description: Apply for and track official Bonafide, Transfer, Conduct, and Custodian certificates.

request.description: Status of certificate applications (Pending Review, Approved, Issued, Rejected).
Applies for Bonafide, Transfer, Conduct, or Study certificates with purpose statement.

item.name: Exam Registration
item.description: Semester end-term examination registrations and downloadable official hall tickets.

request.description: Active exam registrations, approved hall ticket bar-codes, and designated exam hall numbers.
Registers student for regular or backlog end-semester examination subjects.

item.name: Student Academic Diary
item.description: Daily campus academic diary, circulars, lesson updates, and day-to-day notices.

request.description: Daily diary bulletins published by department heads and academic deans.
Working days vs. non-instructional days as tracked in student academic planner.

item.name: Hostel Accommodation
item.description: Allocated hostel room, bed, block, and day/night outing gate pass requests.

request.description: Assigned hostel block name, floor, room number, bed ID, and resident warden contact.
Track day outing, weekend leave, and vacation gate pass permissions.
Submits gate pass request with out/in times and guardian consent notification.

item.name: Campus Transport & Bus
item.description: Active bus pass, designated bus route, vehicle number, and pick-up/drop-off stops.

item.name: 01. Get My Transport Subscription & Bus Pass

request.description: Active digital bus pass, designated route name, vehicle number, driver name, and allocated boarding stop.
Subscribes student to an institutional transport route.

item.name: Grievance & Support
item.description: Confidential student grievance desk, ragging redressal, and helpdesk support tickets.

request.description: Track filed grievances, assigned grievance cell officer, and official redressal response remarks.
Submits support ticket across Academic, Hostel, Transport, or General categories.

item.name: Course Feedback
item.description: End-semester faculty evaluations, curriculum feedback, and teaching performance ratings.

request.description: Review previous course evaluation submissions and survey completion statuses.
Submits anonymous rating and qualitative feedback for course teacher.
